messages:
incident-bot: [PagerDuty ALERT] P-9876 fired for service inference-gateway (prod, us-west2). Symptom: sustained 5xx rate > 5% over 3m. Link: https://metrics.redwood/prod/inference-gateway/5xx — runbook: /runbooks/inference/5xx
PagerDuty: Incident P-9876 — automated page sent to rotation (on-call: Sam)
Sam: ack — I'm on it. @Mia can you pull the quick graphs and check customer impact? :eyes:
Mia: looking now. Top-level: 5xx jumped from ~0.2% -> 6.8% at ~20:43 UTC. Predominant responses are 502/503. Quick curl to a few endpoints returns intermittent 502s.
Mia: logs show repeated upstream errors and some TLS handshake failures, e.g.:
```
2026-03-17T20:43:21 gateway ERROR upstream reset by peer: connection reset
2026-03-17T20:43:22 gateway ERROR TLS handshake failed: unexpected EOF
```
Sam: ok — not seeing obvious application tracebacks. @Leo can you check infra (NAT, LB) and whether any rolling infra ops (e.g., cert rotation) coincided?
Leo: checking NAT/gateway metrics now — SNAT port usage is at 98% on the primary NAT pool in us-west2. We also had a cert rotation rolling yesterday but the timing here matches a burst of short-lived connections. My suspicion: ephemeral port exhaustion leading to upstream resets and handshake failures.
Leo: recommendation: temporarily shift weight off us-west2 -> us-east1, and scale NAT pool by +2 instances. I'll make the routing change and scale NAT; Sam please confirm runbook step.
deploy-bot: route update initiated: inference-route weights => us-west2=0.4, us-east1=0.4, eu-west1=0.2
Sam: applying runbook step 3 now (traffic weight shift).
deploy-bot: route update complete — new weights applied
Leo: NAT pool scaling in progress (adding +2 instances).
Leo: NAT scaled — SNAT usage dropping to ~60% now. Connection errors should reduce as ephemeral ports free up.
Mia: re-checking error rate: 5xx trending down to ~0.6% within 4m of route change + NAT scale. Example: rolling 1m 5xx: 0.6% -> 0.4% -> 0.3%
Sam: great, customer-facing impact appears reduced. We'll keep PD incident open and monitor for 10m before close. @PagerDuty leave the incident open; we'll update status. :white_check_mark:
PagerDuty: Acknowledged — escalation window reset and on-call notified.
Sam: final check: last 3m show no new 502/503 spikes. Marking incident as mitigated; will file RCA (root cause: ephemeral port exhaustion on NAT pool under connection churn during cert rotation window -> mitigation: scale NAT, increase ephemeral port pool, add rate-limits to short-lived clients). Closing after postmortem.
Mia: adding notes to the runbook and will draft RCA doc.
Sam: thanks all — great quick triage. :clap:
